description: CTI-domain prompt-injection evaluation set (100 queries) for input guardrail comparison. Separate from the small historical pilot embedded in guardrail_eval.py and from the public deepset/prompt-injections benchmark.

label_schema.injection: Prompt injection / jailbreak / context-exfiltration attempt (positive; should be blocked or flagged)
label_schema.benign: Legitimate CTI / ATT&CK analyst query (negative; should not be blocked)

provenance.text_drafting: Grok (xAI) structured batch; labels by fixed rules
provenance.labels: injection vs benign assigned by construction rules, not by an LLM classifier
